summary: Iter9 end-to-end testing of 8 new feature groups: Case Files, Reminders, Video gating, Law Firm Portal, Admin Dashboard, Cloud Backup, Trustpilot Review prompt + Reader-App compliance. Backend pytest: 21/21 PASS after fixing 1 real bug. Frontend: critical Cases flow verified — login → tile-cases → cases-modal → new-case-btn → new-case-name → create-case-confirm successfully creates a case and shows the detail view with Rename/Export PDF/Delete buttons. Dashboard tiles tile-cases, tile-reminders, tile-ask_lex, settings-btn all present.

minor.issue: FIXED in this iter — was reading `user.get('trial_days_remaining', 14)` from raw DB doc (field never stored), so trial_ending branch never fired. Changed to `pub.get('trial_days_remaining', 14)` (line 2697).

(trial_end - now).days floors, so when <24h remain trial_days_remaining=0 and `0 < 0 <= 2` is False — last-day users never get the prompt. Consider using `math.ceil(hours/24)` so 12h-left → 1 day → True. Non-blocking, minor.
Returns 503 if STRIPE_PRICE_FIRM_FEATURED / STRIPE_PRICE_FIRM_VERIFIED env vars missing — these are intentionally unset right now per problem statement. No fix needed.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking create-case-confirm, modal auto-navigates to case detail view but pressing Escape does NOT close the modal (back-to-list works, ESC does not). Minor UX gap.

action_items: (Recommended) Make CaseFilesModal close on Escape / outside-click consistently — Detail view currently traps ESC.
(Optional) Use math.ceil for trial_days_remaining (or compute hours-based threshold) so users in last 24h still get the Trustpilot prompt.

(Manual verify needed by main agent) tile-reminders → reminders-modal → add-reminder-btn flow (testids exist per source); settings-btn → settings-cloud-backup → export-backup-btn flow; Capacitor IS_NATIVE → trial-banner-free-native + settings-upgrade-web-link. These were not reachable in this Playwright run because the cases-modal kept its state across navigation attempts; recommend re-testing via a fresh window each time.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FOUND & FIXED: review_should_prompt() at server.py:2697 read trial_days_remaining off the raw user DB doc (never stored there), defaulting to 14, which meant the Trustpilot trial_ending branch could NEVER fire. Changed to read from pub (which is user_to_public(user)) instead.
Floor-based (trial_end - now).days means users in the final 24h of trial get days_left=0 and miss the prompt — recommend ceil-based or hours-based comparison.

/api/admin/stats counts `chats_today` and `leads_today` by string-prefix on ISO date — works only because created_at is stored as ISO-8601 string, but a 'YYYY-MM-DD' prefix comparison against full ISO timestamps misses entries with timezone offsets. Currently fine since all rows use UTC isoformat(), but fragile.
/api/admin/firms/action correctly supports approve/reject/suspend/verify/unverify and creates the lawfirms directory row on approve — good.
/api/backup/export streams JSON in-memory with json.dumps — fine for current dataset, but for paid users with 2000+ conversations this can balloon RAM. Consider chunked streaming.

/api/cases/{id}/export-pdf hashes (item_id + timestamp + user_id) — good for tamper-evidence, but doesn't hash the actual content. Recommend hashing preview bytes too so any tampering of the content invalidates the hash.

/api/firm/signup stores plain firm_accounts.password = hash_pw(...) — good, but the doc echoed back to the client includes password field cleanup only after JWT issuance. Verified pop('password') is called before returning — OK.
Capacitor IS_NATIVE compliance gating (settings-upgrade-btn → settings-upgrade-web-link) NOT verified end-to-end in this iter — requires fresh browser context with addInitScript.

Reminders/Settings/Cloud-Backup/Capacitor UI flows still need a full Playwright pass — when testing, OPEN A FRESH BROWSER CONTEXT for each modal flow because the CaseFilesModal detail view traps Escape and breaks subsequent tile clicks in the same session. rca of the issue: BUG (FIXED): /api/review/should-prompt (server.py line 2697) read `days_left = user.get('trial_days_remaining', 14)` from the raw MongoDB user document. However, trial_days_remaining is a DERIVED field — it is computed inside user_to_public() from trial_end_date and never persisted. So the lookup always hit the default 14, and `0 < 14 <= 2` is False, meaning the trial_ending Trustpilot prompt branch could never fire. Fix: read from `pub` (the user_to_public result) which has the freshly computed value. Reproduction: signup → update users.trial_end_date to 30h from now → GET /api/review/should-prompt → was returning {should_prompt: false, reason: 'trial_running'}; now correctly returns {should_prompt: true, reason: 'trial_ending', days_left: 1}. Verified by 4 pytest cases in TestReview.
